x: D is the wrong pair: the Lahore protest was led by Lala Lajpat Rai; S. Satyamurthy was president of the Andhra Boycott Committee. The other pairs are correct: Unnayya Sastri led protests at Tenali and Guntur, Bulusu Sambamurti toured Andhra, and Ayyadevara Kaleswara Rao led the Vijayawada boycott.

Kheda (1918) is classed as Gandhi's first non-cooperation. The other pairs are wrong: Champaran (1917) was the first civil disobedience, not non-cooperation; Ahmedabad (1918) was the first hunger strike, not an all-India strike; the Rowlatt Satyagraha (1919, hartal) was the first all-India mass movement, not the first civil disobedience.

B is the intended key: Kasinathuni Nageswara Rao was president of the Vijayawada branch (the Andhra branches were at Hyderabad and Vijayawada, 1932). The notes list Maganti Bapineedu as the Vijayawada branch's secretary, not Hyderabad's, so B's second pair is loose. A wrongly puts Nageswara Rao at Hyderabad; C names the national president and secretary (Birla, Thakkar Bapa); D names other women leaders.
